name: Recursive Thought Expansion
apply_effect: Loops halving a local copy of free_energy until <= NOISE_FLOOR or 9 steps, adds the step count to ctx.rung (cap 9), stores the halved free_energy, returns +0.05 (recipe_kernels.rs:467-477). No expansion of any thought; pure arithmetic on two scalars.
consumed_by: field-overlap only: Rung->8,23; FreeEnergy->10,21,23,31 (sequential run_ladder: Rte spends free_energy before Amp reads it; recipe_dispatch.rs:291-293)
missing_operand: a set of sub-thoughts/statements to expand and a convergence test over them (catalogue cites SigmaTierBands::jirak_p; not read)

name: Hierarchical Thought Decomposition
apply_effect: Partitions candidates around their mean and rewrites the vector as [>=mean..., <mean...] (stable reorder, same values) (recipe_kernels.rs:498-503). No hierarchy is produced; groups are not addressable.
creates_addressable_output: no (reordered f32 vector, group boundary not recorded)
missing_operand: a compound term/task with components; a CLAM tree (catalogue) is not read

name: Structured Multi-Agent Debate
apply_effect: Computes max(candidates, floor 0.0) - min(candidates, ceiling 1.0); spread<0.3 returns +0.1 else -0.05 (recipe_kernels.rs:524-536). No agents, no positions, no blackboard.
closest_nal: none (loosely NAL-1 revision/choice, but no truth values are combined)
missing_operand: agent positions with truth values and a blackboard round (a2a_blackboard / InnerCouncil named in catalogue, not read)

name: Reverse Causality Reasoning
apply_effect: Reverses the order of ctx.candidates in place (recipe_kernels.rs:557-561). Nothing causal is read; the note claims 'SPO backward S_O'.
consumed_by: field-overlap only: Candidates->(21 candidate readers, see HTD)
closest_nal: none (name resembles NAL-1 abduction; no premises exist)
missing_operand: SPO statements / causal edges (S_O plane, CausalEdge64) and an observed effect to abduce from

name: Thought Chain Pruning
apply_effect: floor = mean(candidates)*(1-sd); retains candidates >= floor; returns +0.05 (recipe_kernels.rs:581-588). Gate bucket: run() only fires when sd>=SD_FLOW (recipe_kernels.rs:366-371).
closest_nal: none (control-level budget pruning, not a NAL rule)
missing_operand: branches with their own truth values (chain elements), not anonymous scores

name: Thought Randomization
apply_effect: Adds +amp to even indices and -amp to odd, amp=max(temperature*0.1, NOISE_FLOOR), clamped 0..1 (recipe_kernels.rs:608-615). Deterministic, not random. Gate bucket: gate() also reads Sd, undeclared in requires.
missing_operand: a generator of alternative thoughts; there is nothing to randomize but scores

name: Adversarial Self-Critique
apply_effect: If ctx.confidence > 0.6 returns +0.05 else -0.15 (recipe_kernels.rs:636-647). No belief is negated or challenged; the outcome is a threshold on the confidence scalar it then moves.
closest_nal: none (name suggests NAL-5 negation; no statement exists to negate)
missing_operand: a top belief as a statement plus its negation and evidence for/against

name: Conditional Abstraction Scaling
apply_effect: steps = hdr_level(rung) in {1,4,8,32}; each candidate := round(c*steps)/steps (recipe_kernels.rs:674-680). Gate bucket: gate() also reads Sd (undeclared).
missing_operand: an HDR cascade over real fingerprints (INT1/4/8/32); here only a scalar grid

name: Iterative Roleplay Synthesis
apply_effect: Multiplies every candidate by (0.5+temperature), clamped 0..1 (recipe_kernels.rs:700-706). Not iterative; no persona object.
missing_operand: persona FieldModulation records and per-persona outputs to synthesize

name: Meta-Cognition Prompting
apply_effect: If confidence > 0.7 AND free_energy > 0.5 returns delta_conf = -0.2 (note 'lowered overconfident estimate (Brier)'), else 0.0; mutates nothing (recipe_kernels.rs:726-737). Verdict is a pure function of two scalars; no past prediction or outcome is read.
reads_prior_object: no (two scalars of the current ctx only; planner tests/mcp_receipt_probe.rs:58-86 shows all other fields are ignored and :1-31 shows it is history-blind)
creates_addressable_output: no (delta_conf only; ExecutedStep from run_recipes is not handed to any later recipe)
parity_evidence: none in production; test-local mcp_receipt_probe.rs (lance-graph-planner/tests) shows a receipt reader over LearningLoop separates histories MCP cannot
missing_operand: a RECEIPT history: ExecutedStep + confidence left behind + later observed outcome + stable identity (Tactic::apply takes &mut ThoughtCtx only, so it cannot be handed one)

name: Contradiction Resolution
apply_effect: Scans ctx.beliefs pairwise; if two share topic_id with |f1-f2| > 0.5 returns -0.2 ('contradiction detected (preserved)'), else 0.0; nothing is resolved or revised (recipe_kernels.rs:757-776).
reads_prior_object: partially: reads (topic,f,c) tuples, which Cdi/Cws may have pushed earlier in a sequential run, but by value in a Vec, not by identity; confidence component of each belief is ignored
closest_nal: NAL-1 revision precondition (two judgments on the same statement) / NARS choice; no revision rule applied
missing_operand: statements with terms (not a bare u32 topic) and evidence weights to revise; truth-value combination

name: Temporal Context Augmentation
apply_effect: If non-empty, rotate_right(1) on candidates (recipe_kernels.rs:798-803). No time index is read; 'Granger lag' is a vector rotation.
missing_operand: timestamped events / a temporal stream (Granger lane, Markov ±5) — absent from ThoughtCtx

name: Convergent & Divergent Thinking
apply_effect: temperature>0.5: c := fract(c + 0.05*i*temperature) for index i, delta 0; else collapses candidates to [max] and returns +0.05 (recipe_kernels.rs:825-838). Gate bucket: gate() also reads Sd (undeclared).
closest_nal: NAL-1 choice (convergent branch picks max); divergent branch none
missing_operand: alternative hypotheses to generate (divergent) rather than perturbed scores

name: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
apply_effect: Replaces candidates with [mean(candidates)] (recipe_kernels.rs:858-866). No modalities exist.
missing_operand: per-modality representations (NSM/Causality/Qualia fingerprints, GrammarTriangle)

name: Latent Space Introspection
apply_effect: Writes ctx.sd := population std-dev of candidates (recipe_kernels.rs:888-895). The ONLY kernel that writes a field it does not require.
consumed_by: Sd -> 5 TCP, 28 SSAM, 33 DTMF (declared); also gate() of Gate-bucket 6,8,13,20,26 (undeclared). The one real cross-field producer edge in the catalogue
missing_operand: fingerprint clusters (CRP / Mexican-hat named in catalogue)

name: Prompt Scaffold Optimization
apply_effect: Sorts candidates descending (recipe_kernels.rs:915-919).
missing_operand: ThinkingTemplate slots and a learned scaffold

name: Cognitive Dissonance Induction
apply_effect: Pushes a fabricated belief (topic of beliefs[0] or 0, f=0.1, c=0.6) and adds +0.3 to dissonance (cap 1) (recipe_kernels.rs:940-946). Evidence is invented, not observed.
creates_addressable_output: no addressable output: an appended (u32,f32,f32) tuple, no identity/provenance
consumed_by: Beliefs -> 11 CR, 18 CWS; Dissonance -> (17 itself only). A Cdi->Cr pair is semantically real (the injected f=0.1 trips CR when beliefs[0].f>0.6) but is invisible to the scheduler because both require Beliefs
closest_nal: none (contradicts NAL evidential semantics: a belief with c=0.6 from no evidence)
missing_operand: a similar-fingerprint belief with real opposing evidence (catalogue: 'opposing NARS truth on similar fp')

name: Context Window Simulation
apply_effect: If a max candidate exists, pushes (u32::MAX, best, confidence) onto beliefs (recipe_kernels.rs:971-976). Never reads beliefs content; 'Beliefs' in requires is over-declared (apply only appends), which hides a would-be Cws->Cr edge from the scheduler.
creates_addressable_output: closest thing in the catalogue to an output object: a belief tuple tagged with sentinel topic u32::MAX — not addressable (sentinel shared by every checkpoint), lives only in the per-lane ctx copy, discarded by wave_dispatch
missing_operand: a persistent store with stable addresses (BindSpace / WitnessCorpus / episodic memory)

name: Algorithmic Reverse Engineering
apply_effect: Ignores ctx; XORs two hardcoded u32 constants and debug-asserts recovery; returns 0.0 (recipe_kernels.rs:998-1003).
missing_operand: identity fingerprints of a bound pair to unbind (identity-fingerprint rail, not exposed to kernels)

name: Thought Cascade Filtering
apply_effect: Replaces candidates with [median] (upper median), returns +0.05 (recipe_kernels.rs:1024-1031). Gate bucket: gate() also reads Sd (undeclared).
missing_operand: N independent strategy outputs (catalogue) rather than N scalars

name: Self-Skepticism Reinforcement
apply_effect: Returns delta = -0.1*max(0, confidence - min(free_energy,1)) (recipe_kernels.rs:1052-1055). No challenge schedule, no state between runs.
missing_operand: a challenge schedule with outcomes per challenged belief

name: Emergent Task Decomposition
apply_effect: Sorts a copy, finds the widest adjacent gap; if gap > NOISE_FLOOR replaces candidates with the upper cluster (recipe_kernels.rs:1088-1107); else unchanged.
creates_addressable_output: no (the lower cluster is discarded, not emitted as a subtask)
missing_operand: subtask objects (CLAM cluster geometry)

name: Adaptive Meta-Prompting
apply_effect: If free_energy > 0.5, rung := min(rung+1, 9) (recipe_kernels.rs:1128-1133). No Q-values, no learning.
missing_operand: ThinkingStyle Q-values and reward history (TD learning)

name: Zero-Shot Concept Fusion
apply_effect: Ignores ctx; XORs constants 0x0A,0xB0 and debug-asserts recoverability (recipe_kernels.rs:1155-1160).
missing_operand: two concept identity fingerprints

name: Hyperdimensional Pattern Matching
apply_effect: Replaces candidates with [the candidate nearest to the fixed target 0.5] (recipe_kernels.rs:1182-1193). No query, no fingerprints.
missing_operand: a query fingerprint and a codebook to sweep

name: Cascading Uncertainty Reduction
apply_effect: Repeatedly keeps candidates >= mean until 1 remains or all within NOISE_FLOOR of mean; always returns +0.1 (recipe_kernels.rs:1215-1227) — confidence rises even when nothing was reduced. Gate bucket: gate() also reads Sd (undeclared).
missing_operand: free-energy/CRP percentiles per hypothesis (catalogue)

name: Multi-Perspective Compression
apply_effect: Replaces candidates with [mean] (recipe_kernels.rs:1248-1252). Identical body to MCT (14).
closest_nal: NAL-1 revision (loosely: averages, no evidence weights)
missing_operand: bundled perspectives (per-bit majority over fingerprints) with a delta encoding

name: Self-Supervised Analogical Mapping
apply_effect: Returns delta = 0.1*((1-sd) - 0.5) (recipe_kernels.rs:1273-1276). No A, B or C term exists; 'analogy' is a linear function of the dispersion scalar.
missing_operand: statements A->B and C<->A with truth values (NAL analogy premises); bind+similarity over fingerprints

name: Intent-Driven Reframing
apply_effect: Replaces candidates with [max] (recipe_kernels.rs:1298-1304).
missing_operand: GrammarTriangle CausalityFlow roles (agent/action/patient/reason)

name: Shadow Parallel Processing
apply_effect: path_a = mean(candidates); path_b = (max+min)/2 (max floored 0, min ceilinged 1); |a-b|<0.1 returns +0.1 else -0.05 (recipe_kernels.rs:1325-1338). The two 'paths' are two statistics of the same vector, not independent computations.
missing_operand: two independently executed reasoning paths with their own outputs to compare

name: Iterative Counterfactual Reasoning
apply_effect: sensitivity = |(1-fe)*conf - fe*conf| = |1-2fe|*conf; if > NOISE_FLOOR returns -(sensitivity*0.15) else 0 (recipe_kernels.rs:1390-1403). Its own doc (:1350-1389) states it is NOT a counterfactual and severs nothing.
closest_nal: none (catalogue claims Pearl rung 3; code explicitly is not)
parity_evidence: icr_charges_pole_dependence_and_is_silent_at_the_midpoint (recipe_kernels.rs:2139) verifies the sensitivity probe, which is NOT the catalogued capability
missing_operand: a causal model with mechanisms to sever (do-operator), exogenous background, factual world; tracked ISS-PEARL-VOCABULARY-WITHOUT-PEARL-MECHANICS

name: Semantic Distortion Detection
apply_effect: dev = |mean(candidates) - 0.5|; if > NOISE_FLOOR returns -(min(dev,1)*0.2); empty or within floor returns 0 (recipe_kernels.rs:1440-1451). The 'reciprocal A->B, B->A validation' half of the catalogue is absent.
missing_operand: reciprocal statement pairs A->B / B->A to validate

name: Dynamic Task Meta-Framing
apply_effect: If gate_state(sd) == Block, temperature := min(temperature+0.3, 1) (recipe_kernels.rs:1473-1477). No template is switched.
missing_operand: a template/frame set to switch between (ThinkingTemplate)

name: Hyperdimensional Knowledge Fusion
apply_effect: Ignores ctx; XORs three hardcoded constants and debug-asserts recovery (recipe_kernels.rs:1508-1513).
